verdict.rationale: Vanta ships automations of its own (automated tests, Custom Tests, workflows, agentic features), so versioning, reviewing and rolling back those automations is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no version history, change review, or rollback for any Vanta automation. The Claude Code plugin's draft pull request applies to the user's own infrastructure-as-code remediation, not to Vanta automations, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
